# MPI004 `collective-in-rank-branch`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

An MPI collective is called inside a branch that depends on the rank.

## Why

Every process of the communicator must call a collective (`mpi_bcast`, `mpi_allreduce`,
`mpi_barrier`, ...), in the same order. Called inside `if (rank == 0)`, the other ranks never reach
it and the program hangs, or matches it with a different collective and computes garbage. Move the
collective out of the branch; if the branch selects exactly the members of a sub-communicator
passed to the call, suppress with a reason. The rank variables are those filled by `mpi_comm_rank`
anywhere in the project.

## Reported

```fortran
if (myrank == 0) then
  read(u, *) dt
  call mpi_bcast(dt, 1, MPI_REAL8, 0, comm, ierr)
end if
```

## Preferred

```fortran
if (myrank == 0) read(u, *) dt
call mpi_bcast(dt, 1, MPI_REAL8, 0, comm, ierr)
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[MPI004] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = MPI004` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).
